newsitem.title: DUBAI: Some Saudi riyal interbank deposits 1/16 lower.
newsitem.headline: Some Saudi riyal interbank deposits 1/16 lower.

text.p: Some Saudi riyal interbank deposits were around 1/16 lower in the week to Thursday, dealers said.
One-month deposits were flat at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, while three-month funds were quoted 1/16 lower at 5-9/16, 7/16.
Six-month funds were at 5-11/16, 9/16 from 5-3/4, 5/8 and one-year deposits were at 5-13/16, 11/16 from 5-7/8, 3/4.
The spot Saudi riyal was stable on the dollar at 3.7503/6.
